meta.title: LisanHub — community language learning
meta.description: Learn any language from any language, with content the community creates, reviews and improves.

home.title: Learn any language, starting from yours
home.lede: A platform whose content is built together by learners, native speakers and content creators: lessons, exercises and review cards for every language pair.
home.pillarsTitle: What the platform is built on

freedom.title: Learn freely
freedom.body: No single mandatory path. Move between lessons and resources according to your level and interests.

community.title: Content from the community
community.body: Content creators publish, translate and improve, with clear attribution and a record of every change.

progress.title: Your progress is always kept
progress.body: Your progress and review dates are stored for free in your account and follow you to any device.

role.title: Your role in the community
role.studentExplanation: A student learns, tracks progress and keeps personal copies of lessons on their own device; they never publish content to the community.
role.creatorExplanation: As a content creator you can create lessons and cards, publish them to the community, and make your own version of other people's lessons or translate them. The creation tools arrive in the next stage.
role.ownerNote: As the platform owner no rank or role limits you: every permission is open to you, and you can try the platform with narrower permissions from the “View the platform as” bar at the top of the page.

advanced.contributorIntro: Or, if you would rather build new kinds of activities (plugins) than author content:

creator.title: Become a content creator
creator.lede: One step changes the nature of your account. Read the commitments, then confirm.

commitments.publish: What you publish becomes available to the whole community; others can make their own version of it or translate it, with attribution to you.
commitments.attribution: Your name stays attached to everything you publish and to every derived version.
commitments.rules: You follow the community rules: original or reusable educational content, without abuse or rights violations.
commitments.review: New content carries the “new community content” label until the founding team reviews it, and the community can report it.
commitments.noReturn: You cannot return to a student account by yourself; that goes through support after a review of your case.

creator.acknowledge: I have read the commitments and understand this change is only undone through support.

support.title: Contact support
support.body: Write to us here; your request reaches the moderation team directly and you can follow its status below.

hints.revert_to_student: Briefly explain why you want to return to a student account. Support reviews your case and decides.
hints.other: Any question or problem with your account. Suggestions about the platform will get their own form later.

submit.revert_to_student: Request a return to a student account

support.sent: Request sent. The reply will appear here and in your notifications.

avatar.title: Profile picture
avatar.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to {mb} MB. Shown as a circle.
avatar.confirmUpload: Replace your picture with this one?

contributor.title: Becoming a contributor
contributor.lede: A contributor builds activity kinds (plugins) and their templates in the studio, and does not author content. One step changes the nature of your account; read the commitments, then confirm.

commitments.build: You build plugins from inside the platform, in the studio, without code: the item structure, its fields, its templates and its translations in Arabic, French and English.
commitments.review: Publishing your plugin to the public catalogue goes through moderation review at this stage; it may be refused for a stated reason, and you can revise and ask again.
commitments.sandbox: Every plugin runs in a sandbox that reaches no user data, and carries no executable code at this stage.
commitments.attribution: Your name stays attached to every plugin you publish and is shown to the creators who build on it.
commitments.onePath: An account is never both a content creator and a contributor. If you want to author content later, the switch goes through support.
commitments.noReturn: You cannot return to a Student account by yourself; support does it after reviewing your case.

contributor.acknowledge: I have read the commitments and understand that this change is reversed only through support.
contributor.alreadyContributor: Your account is already a contributor account.
contributor.onePathOnly: Your account is a content creator account, and an account never holds both paths. To become a contributor, send a request to support.
contributor.backToAdvanced: Back to account type and support

studio.title: Plugin Studio
studio.lede: This is where a kind of activity is built: its item structure, fields, scoring and templates, without code. The content itself is authored by content creators in their editor.

mine.title: My plugins

mine.activities: {count, plural, =0 {no activities} one {# activity} other {# activities}}
mine.templates: {count, plural, =0 {no templates} one {# template} other {# templates}}

create.title: New plugin
create.lede: Choose a permanent identifier and a name in each language. Everything else is built in the following sections.
create.pluginIdHint: Lowercase Latin letters, digits and hyphens, for example complete-the-dialogue. It never changes after publication.
create.name: Name
create.nameHint: In English; it is the reference name of the plugin. Arabic and French translations are optional.

info.title: Definition
info.lede: The name and description (in English, with two optional translations), the version number to publish and the schema version.
info.name: Name
info.versionHint: In the form x.y.z. Must be new at every publication.
info.schemaVersionHint: Raised only for a breaking change of the item structure (usually stays 1).
info.allowImages: The plugin allows pictures inside packages (required if it has a picture field)
info.englishFirst: The English name and description are required; Arabic and French are optional translations shown instead for members using that language.

activities.title: Activities
activities.lede: Each activity is a kind of item a package may contain: its fields from the catalogue, the graded field and its evaluator.
activities.empty: No activities yet. Add the first one to define the item structure.

activity.lede: Compose the item structure from the field-type catalogue, then choose the field the learner answers. The schema and the editor fields are generated automatically.
activity.idHint: Lowercase Latin letters, digits and hyphens.
activity.name: Name
activity.fieldsLede: In the order the content creator and the learner will see. Each field has a fixed key and an English label, with two optional translations.
activity.label: Label
activity.scoringLede: Scores are computed by the platform's reference evaluators; the plugin only chooses the field and the evaluator and carries no scoring logic.
activity.selfAssessment: Self-assessment: the learner reveals the hidden fields, then rates their own recall
activity.revealFields: Fields hidden until the learner reveals them:

templates.title: Templates
templates.lede: A template is a starting skeleton for the creator: which activities to begin with and a hint per field. It carries no sentence of content.
templates.empty: No templates yet. A template spares the creator a blank page.
templates.needActivity: Add at least one activity before creating a template.

template.lede: Choose the activities the template starts with and write a hint for each field. Fields always stay empty.
template.name: Name
template.itemsLede: Each item points at an activity, with optional hints in each language.

preview.title: Preview in the sandboxed player
preview.lede: Fill a throwaway item as a creator would, then show it in the very player learners will use. Nothing on this page is saved.
preview.fixFirst: Fix the definition until it matches the contract (see Overview) before previewing.
preview.empty: Fill the item, then press “Show in the player”.
preview.instantNote: Display only; the authoritative score is computed on the server and a frame result is never stored.
preview.answerReceived: Answer as received from the frame

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.lede: The schema is generated from the activities. Pasting a schema by hand is an escape hatch for special cases only, and may make the editor diverge from what packages accept.
advanced.customTitle: Paste a JSON Schema by hand (advanced)
advanced.useCustom: Use the pasted schema instead of the generated one
advanced.schemaHint: Validated against the meta-schema before saving.

overview.contractOk: The definition matches the contract: {activities, plural, one {# activity} other {# activities}} and {templates, plural, =0 {no templates} one {# template} other {# templates}}.
